title: Playbook domain capability descriptor
description: Explicit descriptor of a domain capability: what version it is at, which credential binding scopes it requires and what permissions it carries. Published BEFORE invocation (engineering_playbook_list / createCapabilityHost().listCapabilities()) so that permissions are never discovered by executing the call (AC-116). Vocabulary is P13's: ai-agent-runner src/mcp/capabilities.ts.

capabilityId.description: Stable domain capability id, e.g. engineering.playbook.get. Same id as in the runner's capability registry (P13).

capabilityVersion.description: Version of this capability contract. A call with a different explicit version is refused (CAPABILITY_VERSION_UNKNOWN).

effect.description: read = no external effect; write = must return a verifiable effect receipt (PR-16).

requiredScopes.description: Credential binding scopes without which the capability cannot execute. The binding VALUE is host-owned and never model-visible.

requiredArguments.description: Mandatory arguments; absence yields missing_input instead of an invented result.

retrySafety.description: How a repeat of the same operationId behaves: read_only = nothing to repeat, idempotent = the same effect and the same receipt, never a second effect.

requiresGtdId.description: Whether the capability can only run inside a GTD-managed task. False = advisory retrieval is allowed without any gtdId.

transports.description: Facades over the same handler: mcp:<tool> for the MCP interface, internal-api for the control-plane call. The business logic lives once.

execution.description: What the handler is allowed to do. retrieval_only/catalog_read never start a plan.
